sources.snippet: m-a-p/1.3B-100B-GatedDeltaNet-pure, pruned to 90% sparsity with EHWS two-phase ADMM. The sparsity is semi-structured: every row of every prunable linear layer keeps the same number of weights (the top 10%). Embeddings and lm_head stay dense. Weights are float32.
